This suppresses CVEs related to a HAPI-FHIR parent pom that no longer exists in fhir-test-cases

OpenTelemetry is only inherited from hapi-fhir: opentelemetry-instrumentation-annotations is declared in the hapi-fhir parent pom's dependencies, and opentelemetry-api/context/common arrive transitively via hapi-fhir-base. This project declares no OpenTelemetry dependency and has no OTel SDK, exporter or propagator configured. Many OTel CVEs are false positives: NVD uses one vendor/product CPE for every language implementation. Direct use is blocked by checkstyle (NoOpenTelemetry) and enforcer (dependencyEnforcement profile).
